posted_text:
🏢 MI SB 1141 — Michigan Defines Tax Increment Revenues – Key Changes Coming

Michigan is clarifying how tax increment financing (TIF) works.

This bill defines key terms like ‘advance’ and ‘captured assessed value,’ outlining how municipalities can use these funds.

Specifically, it states that TIF revenues *do not* include property taxes paid through ‘specific local taxes’ – like local sales taxes – and clarifies the calculation of ‘captured assessed value’ as the difference between current assessed property values and the initial assessed value at the time the TIF plan is approved.

The bill also establishes that the state tax commission will determine the method for calculating these values.

Sept. 9, 2026: Senate Co-sponsor(s) Named: Mary Cavanagh.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://legislature.mi.gov/Bills/Bill?ObjectName=2026-SB-1141
